title: Iran’s Economy Minister Tells US Treasury Secretary Bessent: ‘You Have Only Three Days Left’
text:
Iran’s Economy Minister Tells US Treasury Secretary Bessent: ‘You Have Only Three Days Left’"

"🔆🔅TEHRAN_ October 8th — Iran’s Minister of Economic Affairs and Finance, Abdolnaser Hemmati, has issued a direct message to US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, saying Bessent has only three days left."

"SOT, Abdolnaser Hemmati, Iran’s Minister of Economic Affairs and Finance (Farsi): “Tell Mr. Bessent [the U.S. Treasury Secretary] that he has only three days left,” "

"The remark came amid rising tensions over US sanctions and recent American claims that pressure would “squash” Iran’s economy and “collapse” its regime. Hemmati did not elaborate on what he meant by the three-day warning."
